alt: 球場上精力旺盛的年輕球員因小爭議衝動發火，隊友扶住他的手臂，教練張開雙手耐心勸阻。
scene_prompt: Meaning: a young person is vigorous and strong but easily impulsive. At a contemporary community basketball court, exactly three people: a strong energetic teenage player has surged forward impulsively after a minor disputed play, face flushed and fists tense but not striking anyone; a calm teenage teammate gently holds his upper arm and gestures for him to pause; a middle-aged coach uses open palms to de-escalate. A basketball and tipped water bottle suggest the sudden burst of emotion. Youthful energy and impulsiveness are clear without violence or danger. Natural anatomy and grounded court equipment.
